name: publish_type comment: 发布方式(定时/手动) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: published_by comment: 发布人(系统/运营) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: published_at comment: 发布时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: snapshot_id comment: 汇率版本号(SNAP-YYYYMMDD-序号) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态(生效/已替换/停用) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rate_change_log comment: 汇率变动日志 note: '操作类型: 定时发布/手动发布; base+target 共同标识有向对; 同批次发布共享 snapshot_batch_id; 配置类操作见 operation_log' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: snapshot_batch_id comment: 发布批次号(可空) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: base_currency_id comment: 基准币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_currency_id comment: 目标币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operation_type comment: 操作类型(定时发布/手动发布) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: old_rate comment: 变更前汇率 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: new_rate comment: 变更后汇率 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: change_reason comment: 变更原因 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operator comment: 操作人 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 操作时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_pair_config comment: 币种对配置 note: 'UK: base+target; 每个有向币种对独立配置模式; 派生方向可独立设固定模式' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: base_currency_id comment: 基准币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_currency_id comment: 目标币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rate_mode comment: 模式(自动/固定) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fixed_rate comment: 固定汇率值(固定模式) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: derivation_type comment: 派生类型(直接/逆向/交叉) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 启停状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_by comment: 更新人 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: exchange_rate_alert comment: 异常告警 note: '告警判定在UTC 0:00发布时执行; 各币种对独立判定互不影响; 状态: 待处理/已处理/已忽略' columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: base_currency_id comment: 基准币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_currency_id comment: 目标币种 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: alert_type comment: 类型(超阈值/固定模式提示) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: current_rate comment: 当前生效汇率 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: new_rate comment: 触发告警的新值 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: deviation_pct comment: 偏离百分比 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: threshold_pct comment: 触发时阈值 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态(待处理/已处理/已忽略) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: handled_action comment: 处理动作(确认发布/忽略/恢复自动) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: handle_reason comment: 处理原因 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: handled_by comment: 处理人 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: handled_at comment: 处理时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 告警生成时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: alert_threshold_config comment: 告警阈值配置 note: 当前生效阈值; 修改历史走 operation_log; exchange_rate_alert.threshold_pct 为触发时快照 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: threshold_pct comment: 当前阈值(0~50,1位小数) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: effective_from comment: 生效时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_by comment: 更新人 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operation_log comment: 操作日志 note: 配置类操作审计; 各功能页底部 OpLog 按 entity_type 过滤展示; 汇率值变动见 rate_change_log columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: entity_type comment: 实体类型(币种对配置/点差规则/数据源/告警阈值) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: entity_id comment: 实体ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operation_type comment: 操作类型(切换自动/切换固定/设固定汇率/点差调整/数据源编辑/阈值编辑/币种停用/主备切换) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: before_value comment: 变更前(JSON/文本) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: after_value comment: 变更后(JSON/文本) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: change_reason comment: 变更原因 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operator comment: 操作人 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 操作时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: exchange_rate_raw to: exchange_rate_source type: N:1 label: 来源 color: '#d97706' penwidth: 1.4 - from: exchange_rate_raw to: currency type: N:1 label: 基准/目标币种 color: '#6b7280' penwidth: 1.2 - from: spread_rule to: currency type: N:1 label: 基准/目标币种(可空) color: '#2563eb' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: exchange_rate_published to: currency type: N:1 label: 基准/目标币种 color: '#4f46e5' penwidth: 1.4 - from: exchange_rate_published to: exchange_rate_raw type: N:1 label: 加工来源 color: '#2563eb' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: exchange_rate_published to: spread_rule type: N:1 label: 应用点差 color: '#2563eb' style: dashed - from: rate_change_log to: currency type: N:1 label: 目标币种 color: '#dc2626' - from: rate_change_log to: exchange_rate_published type: N:1 label: 关联发布记录 color: '#dc2626' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: currency_pair_config to: currency type: N:1 label: 基准/目标币种 color: '#2563eb' penwidth: 1.2 - from: exchange_rate_alert to: currency type: N:1 label: 基准/目标币种 color: '#dc2626' penwidth: 1.2 - from: exchange_rate_alert to: currency_pair_config type: N:1 label: 关联币种对配置 color: '#dc2626' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: exchange_rate_alert to: alert_threshold_config type: N:1 label: 触发时取当前阈值 color: '#2563eb' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed design_rules: naming_alignment: 实体名、字段名与产品架构图保持一致 currency_external: currency 实体来自币种管理模块，本模块只引用不创建 raw_uniqueness: exchange_rate_raw 唯一键 (base_currency_id, target_currency_id, fetched_at)；直接采集仅 USD→X，派生记录 source_id 为空 spread_rule_global: spread_rule 中 base/target 同时为空表示全局点差；方向点差按 priority 覆盖全局 published_active_one: 同一有向币种对在 exchange_rate_published 中仅一条 status=active；币种停用时批量置为 disabled_by_currency rate_change_log_batch: 同一次发布批次的多币种变动共享 snapshot_batch_id，便于回滚整批 pair_config_independent: currency_pair_config 每个有向币种对独立配置模式(自动/固定)，派生方向可独立设固定模式，与源USD→X互不影响 alert_at_publish_time: 告警判定在UTC 0:00发布时执行，非采集时；各币种对独立判定，无级联暂停 alert_recheck_on_handle: 运营处理告警时系统取最新采集值再判一次，未超阈值直接发布，仍超则提示确认 alert_auto_ignore: 同一有向对已有待处理告警时，新告警触发则上一条自动置已忽略；不做超时升级 operation_log_scope: operation_log 记录配置类操作(币种对模式切换/设固定汇率/点差/数据源/阈值/主备切换)，多态 entity_type+entity_id，与记录汇率值变动的 rate_change_log 分工 threshold_config_single: alert_threshold_config 存当前生效阈值，修改历史走 operation_log；告警记录内 threshold_pct 为触发时快照 precision_rule: 汇率服务自身定义汇率小数位(存储NUMERIC(18,8))；currency.decimal_precision 不在本服务使用，仅用于商品定价计算
